guitar.modelsText: Custom "Arm the Homeless" guitar / Fender Telecaster "Soul Power"
guitar.notes: Tom Morello (also of Rage Against the Machine) is the guitarist for Audioslave; his heavily customized "Arm the Homeless" guitar and modified Telecaster are iconic and extremely well documented.

tone.target: dry Marshall crunch with gritty sustain
tone.profile: dry Marshall crunch with gritty sustain
tone.summary: A crunchy, mid-forward signal chain using an AC30 or UK 45 style amp, boosted by a light OD pedal, followed by room ambience and delay for depth.
corrections: drop moderate delay if it sounds too wet
make grit more crunch than fuzz

rig.name: Audioslave - Show Me How To Live - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up hum and unwanted noise.
Provide light overdrive and grit for the 'crunch' sound.
blocks.gap: The Green OD is used to simulate a classic British boost/overdrive tone, fitting the Marshall vibe better than Blues OD or OD 9.

blocks.purpose: Keep the distortion section clean to rely on the Green OD for crunch.
blocks.gap: No dedicated high-gain pedal is needed; the Green OD provides sufficient grit. Setting this block as 'None' and inactive maintains signal integrity.

blocks.purpose: Simulate the classic British Marshall/JCM-style tone with mid-forward punch.
blocks.gap: AC30 TB is the best fit for a vintage, mid-focused British rock sound.

blocks.purpose: Provide the classic British 4x12 cabinet sound.
blocks.gap: Directly matches the 'Marshall/JCM-style amp' and '4x12 cab' clues.

blocks.purpose: Enhance the mid-forward character and tighten the punch.
blocks.gap: Used to manually sculpt the tone towards a more aggressive, mid-focused crunch.

blocks.purpose: Add subtle depth and space without sounding too wet (per corrections).
blocks.gap: The delay is kept minimal to avoid excessive 'wet' sound, fulfilling the correction requirement.

blocks.purpose: Add subtle room ambience for depth and sustain.
blocks.gap: Room reverb is ideal for adding natural space without the artificiality of plate or spring, supporting the 'slight room' requirement.
Standard final stage block for signal management.

improvements.summary: Improve cabinet realism by swapping the current IR for a more aggressive, high-fidelity 4x12 that better captures the tight punch and grit required.

proposals.reason: Enhance tightness and aggressive crunch for palm-muting.
